I don't know if this question has been asked before so I'm sorry if
you've already answered this.

Can I use the Heidelburg to transfer more blood on a vampire than his
capacity alows him to hold?

example.

I tap heidelburg to transfer blood between Arika and Artemis Arika is
at full capacity and Artemis has 2 blood on him can I transfer more
than 4 blood from Arika to Artemis?

Emile
